A status of 3 indicates that the watchdog has been disabled A status of 4 indicates that the watchdog is in debug mode. The register fields WATCHDOG_STATUS_KICK_PENDING and WATCHDOG_STATUS_SLOW_KICK_PENDING indicate if this register has already been written and an update is currently pending.
